name: dsfd_wfc_hep_t-m1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 sp_wfc priced kit, issue-epoch table for the layer 37/38/39 hidden-row senders, REDESIGNED on a macro (the 2 x 13.3k-flop bank split was refused by the pre-route gate: 72k cells, util 70 %, port f_u[1] on 12,661 loads, CTS failed): one ot_sram_1r1w_512x128 (two users a word, masked write) + 1,024 seen flops + pin flops; pins -> macro address / pin flops -> rd_out register -> compare / +1 -> output register (3 edges; the 2-edge form read macro -> macro -197 ps at the pre-route gate). ~1.2k flops on one root. t_hep moves +3 serial cycles in the kit (start register + this tile): the consumer dsfd_mtp_hrow_src queues the event (valid-driven), benches hep_* / posthep_* / prc_* and mtp_wave mut_hep_stale.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_wfc_hep_t u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_wfc_kit.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_hep_t/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_hep_t/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_hep_t --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_wfc_hep_t --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: flop table (26.6k flops, 512:1 read mux from the pins) replaced by one 1R1W SRAM macro with a 3-edge pipeline and two-deep same-user forwarding
